apiContracts: No runtime API changes; source-level regression assertions only.
dataEntities: No data ownership; tests validate client/API integration boundaries.

migrationPlan.rollbackOrForwardRepair: Remove test and its build command if the feature is reverted.

privacySecurity.ownerScoping: Assertions ensure the browser does not supply owner identifiers.
privacySecurity.csrf: No runtime request creation outside the tested application source.

unit: Assert API endpoint wiring, revision token, debounce and offline cache behavior.

stagingSteps: Run as part of the mandatory build on every governed PR.

rollback.codeRollback: Revert the test file and package script entry.
monitoringSignals: Regression test pass/fail in Cloudflare Source Validation.

changeSummary: Adds mandatory regression coverage for the reader progress browser integration.
acceptanceCriteria: Build executes the client regression test.
Bundle parity and optimistic revision behavior are asserted.
